title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on the Application of Relevant Judicial Interpretations and Judicial Policies in Cases Involving the Disposal of Non-performing Assets Stripped During the Shareholding Reform of Agricultural Bank of China Limited
keywords_en: Disposal of Non-Performing Assets Stripped During Shareholding Reform Case
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on the Application of Relevant Judicial Interpretations and Judicial Policies in the Trial of Cases Involving the Disposal of Non-performing Assets Stripped in the Shareholding Reform of Agricultural Bank of China Co., Ltd.

Fa [2011] No. 144

To: Higher People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; and the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the Higher People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

Pursuant to the "Notice of the Ministry of Finance on Issues Concerning the Stripping of Non-performing Assets of Agricultural Bank of China" (Cai Jin [2008] No. 138) and the "Notice on Entrusting Agricultural Bank of China with the Disposal of Non-performing Assets Stripped in the Shareholding Reform" (Cai Jin Han [2009] No. 34), Agricultural Bank of China Co., Ltd. (formerly Agricultural Bank of China, hereinafter referred to as "Agricultural Bank") is entrusted by the Ministry of Finance to dispose of the non-performing assets stripped in its shareholding reform. In order to support the reform of the national financial system, prevent the loss of state-owned assets, ensure the smooth progress of the disposal of non-performing assets, and reduce disposal costs, the following notice is hereby given on issues related to litigation arising from the disposal of non-performing assets by Agricultural Bank:

1. When trying cases involving Agricultural Bank's disposal of the aforementioned non-performing assets, the people's courts may apply the relevant judicial interpretations, judicial policies, and provisions of relevant replies and notices issued by the Supreme People's Court for the trial of cases involving the disposal of non-performing assets by financial asset management companies.

2. The documents certifying the entrusted disposal of assets issued by the Financial Supervision Commissioner's Offices of the Ministry of Finance stationed in all provinces, autonomous regions, municipalities directly under the Central Government, and cities with independent planning status may serve as the basis for the people's courts to confirm that the non-performing assets being disposed of by Agricultural Bank are assets entrusted to it for disposal by the Ministry of Finance.

March 28, 2011
